page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 88 at left. Below it one main text column with a narrow margin of notes at its left. Nothing printed below the text except a catchword-like fragment at the foot, which is a torn running line and is left out.

main_text.p: perum æstimatores, Pontifici­os, qui quæ ipsi fecerint, con­digna cœlo venditent. Quibus nos merito, quod olim Acesió Novatiano Constantinus ; Erigite vobis scalas Papistæ, & ad cœlum soli ascendite : Quis ferat notatissimum illud Bel­larmini ; Homo iustus duplici titulo ius habet ad eandem gloriam, uno ex meritis Christi, sibi per gratiam communicatis, altero, ex meritis propriis : contra quam spiritus sanctus, Stipendia peccati mors ; donum autem Dei vita æterna. In quæ, paulò sanctius Cardinalis alter, Caietanus, Non dicit quod stipendia iniustitiæ

page.notes: Margin notes at left: "Socr.l.1.c.7.", "Rom.6.ad fin.", "Caiet.Com.in 6.ad Rom." Faded marginal text above them is illegible. The last line is cut off at the column foot, reading "iu-" with the continuation "ftitiæ" below the rule; the word is restored from the printed fragment. Some words are uncertain due to the scan quality.
